lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with businesses in the state of Georgia on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Georgia is really two markets: metro Atlanta, one of the largest and fastest-moving urban areas in the South, and the rest of the state, where smaller cities, ports, farms and mountain towns each follow their own rhythm. We plan campaigns for the one you sell in.

sections.heading: Atlanta and everywhere else
paragraphs: Metro Atlanta holds a large share of Georgia's residents and most of its corporate offices. It is home to global brands in soft drinks, airlines, home improvement and parcel delivery, to one of the busiest airports in the world, and to a large film and television industry.

Outside the metro area the state looks different. Savannah combines a historic district full of visitors with one of the busiest container ports in the country. Augusta is known for the Masters each spring and has a large Army post and medical district. Columbus has its own Army post and a major insurance employer. Macon and Warner Robins sit in the middle of the state, Athens is a university town where football Saturdays set the calendar, and the north-west around Dalton makes much of the nation's carpet and flooring.

sections.heading: Industries behind Georgia's growth
paragraphs: Logistics runs through everything: the airport, the port, the interstates that cross in Atlanta and the warehouses along them. Payment processing and financial technology are concentrated around Atlanta's northern suburbs. And south Georgia remains farm country, with peanuts, pecans, poultry and the peaches the state is known for.

Many of these companies sell to other businesses. A freight broker in Savannah or a flooring manufacturer in Dalton needs a site that sets out services, capacity and coverage clearly, and search visibility for the exact terms a buyer uses.
bullets: Metro Atlanta run as its own set of campaigns, split by county or suburb.
Separate plans for Savannah, Augusta, Columbus and Macon, where costs and competitors differ.
Business-to-business pages for logistics, manufacturing and agricultural suppliers.

sections.heading: How Georgians choose a business
paragraphs: Georgia has many counties, more than almost any other state, and people often describe where they live by county as much as by city: Cobb, Gwinnett, Forsyth, Cherokee. Search habits follow. A roofer or family lawyer in the Atlanta suburbs needs county and city names on their pages to match how customers actually type.
The state keeps attracting new residents and employers, and newcomers pick doctors, schools, contractors and churches from search results and reviews.

sections.heading: Seasons and events worth planning for
paragraphs: Georgia summers are long and humid, so air conditioning is an urgent purchase and pest control a steady one. On the coast, Tybee Island and the Golden Isles fill up in summer, and Savannah's St. Patrick's Day celebration is one of the largest in the country. Autumn sends visitors to the mountain towns of Blue Ridge, Ellijay and Helen for leaves, apples and cabins. Masters week transforms Augusta's rental and hospitality market each April.

cards.heading: Georgia sectors we plan campaigns for

presence: TDM works with Georgia businesses remotely. We have no office in the state. Meetings take place by video call, reports are shared online, and strategy, design, development and video editing are delivered by one team.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Georgia?
faqs.a: No. We work with businesses in Georgia remotely, by video call and shared reporting, to a plan agreed with you.

faqs.q: Is marketing in Atlanta different from the rest of Georgia?
faqs.a: Yes. Metro Atlanta has more competitors, higher ad costs and customers spread over many counties. Smaller cities have less competition, and local reputation counts for more. We build separate campaigns for each.

faqs.q: How should a Savannah or coastal Georgia business plan for tourist season?
faqs.a: Have booking pages, photos and listings ready before visitors start researching, which is usually well ahead of spring and summer. Shift ad budget toward the weeks before peak periods and keep hours and availability current on your business profile.

faqs.q: What does a digital marketing agency charge in Georgia?
faqs.a: It depends on scope: the channels, how many locations or counties you cover and the competition in your field. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How soon does SEO work for a Georgia business?
faqs.a: It depends on your requirements, your current site and your competitors. The timeline is agreed in the plan before work starts.
